why: Empty, and it must stay empty until a wave of U+00D7 in a marker position exists in a file the fixing lane does not own. The 110 marker lines this ledger excused - the twelve package.json gate descriptions, the whole falsifier ledger, and four test headers - were repaired, and every entry was reported as red_proof_marker_baseline_stale until it was deleted, which is this mechanism doing its job rather than an inconvenience: an entry identifies one file and one line's exact text, never a line number, so a repaired line expires its entry and a stale entry fails the gate. `node tools/check-red-proof-markers.mjs --write-baseline` records a new wave; repairing the line deletes the entry, deliberately by hand.
